name: Probability Puzzles
description: Solve interview probability puzzles cold, with the shortest clean argument.

lessonNames.l3-waiting-for-hh: Waiting for two heads in a row
lessonNames.l15-exceeding-one: How many uniforms to exceed one?
lessonNames.l25-fair-from-biased: A fair coin from a biased one

lessonObjectives.l1-dice-games: Value a dice game by expectation, and find the best rule for rerolling.
lessonObjectives.l2-every-coupon: Solve the coupon collector problem with linearity.
lessonObjectives.l3-waiting-for-hh: Find the expected flips until a pattern appears with first-step analysis.
lessonObjectives.l4-indicator-tricks: Solve counting expectations with indicator variables.
lessonObjectives.l5-hats: Find the expected number of people who get their own hat back.
lessonObjectives.l6-when-to-stop: Find an optimal stopping rule by comparing the value of stopping and continuing.
lessonObjectives.l7-cards-and-colours: Solve card puzzles by conditioning on the right event.
lessonObjectives.l8-urns: Solve urn puzzles with a symmetry argument.
lessonObjectives.l9-bayes-in-a-minute: Solve interview Bayes questions quickly with natural frequencies.
lessonObjectives.l10-ruin-in-interviews: Apply ruin probabilities to interview questions.
lessonObjectives.l11-largest-of-several: Find the distribution of the maximum and minimum of several draws.
lessonObjectives.l12-ants: Use symmetry to dissolve a complicated set-up.
lessonObjectives.l13-broken-stick: Find the chance that three random pieces form a triangle.
lessonObjectives.l14-semicircle: Find the chance that random points on a circle lie in one semicircle.
lessonObjectives.l15-exceeding-one: Find the expected number of uniform draws until their sum exceeds one.
lessonObjectives.l16-meeting: Solve a meeting problem as an area in a square.
lessonObjectives.l17-buffon: Estimate $\pi$ from the chance that a dropped needle crosses a line.
lessonObjectives.l18-expected-distance: Compute expected distances between random points on a line and in a square.
lessonObjectives.l19-who-wins: Solve a two-player game by backward induction.
lessonObjectives.l20-betting-on-sequences: Value a bet on which of two patterns appears first.
lessonObjectives.l21-kelly: Derive the Kelly fraction for a repeated favourable bet.
lessonObjectives.l22-when-to-hedge: Decide when to hedge a bet that is already running.
lessonObjectives.l23-doubling-up: Show why a doubling strategy cannot beat a fair game.
lessonObjectives.l24-mixed-set: Solve a mixed set of puzzles against a clock, explaining each aloud.
lessonObjectives.l25-fair-from-biased: Make a fair bit from a biased coin and find the expected number of flips.
lessonObjectives.l26-estimating-n: Estimate a population size from serial numbers seen, and correct the maximum's bias.
lessonObjectives.l27-given-the-total: Find chances and expectations for dice and cards given their total or their maximum.
lessonObjectives.l28-duels: Find each player's chance of winning a turn-based shooting game, and the best first move.
lessonObjectives.l29-random-chords: Show how the answer depends on how "random" is defined, with Bertrand's chord and the two envelopes.
lessonObjectives.l30-follow-ups: Extend a solved puzzle the way interviewers do: n-sided dice, more players, a cost per roll.
